purpose: reading-comprehension items; the contradicted item is composed by the pipeline from basis+alter and always shown with its label

statements.label: supported
statements.text: GOT1 transcript levels differed significantly between cancer types, and the gene had strong diagnostic performance in both colon and rectal adenocarcinoma.
statements.evidence: GOT1 expression significantly varied across cancer types, showing high diagnostic value in colon adenocarcinoma and rectal adenocarcinoma.
statements.note: The results state both the variation across cancer types and the high diagnostic value in colon and rectal adenocarcinoma.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Sensitivity to the drugs navitoclax and CCT036477 was associated with GOT1 expression levels.
statements.evidence: Drug sensitivities, including those of navitoclax and CCT036477, showed an association with GOT1 expression.
statements.note: The abstract reports that sensitivity to navitoclax and CCT036477 was associated with GOT1 expression levels.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Knocking down GOT1 in colorectal cancer cell lines reduced their proliferation.
statements.evidence: Nonetheless, its role in tumorigenesis warrants further investigation.
statements.note: This was a database-level analysis; no knockdown or other functional experiment is reported, and the abstract explicitly leaves the tumorigenic role open.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: GOT1 expression tracked with immune cell populations including CD8 + T and plasma cells, and with the immune checkpoint genes LGALS9 and TNFRSF4.
statements.evidence: Moreover, it correlated with immune cells, such as CD8 + T and plasma cells, and immune checkpoint genes LGALS9 and TNFRSF4.
statements.note: The abstract reports exactly these correlations with immune cells and with the two checkpoint genes.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Annotation of the Brandt's vole genome yielded 5,501,822 transposons, with LINEs the most abundant class at 16.61 % of the genome.
statements.evidence: we first annotated 5,501,822 transposons in the whole genome of Brandt's voles (Lasiopodomys brandtii), and revealed that LINEs were the most abundant, comprising 16.61 % of the genome
statements.note: Both the transposon count and the LINE fraction are given as reported.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Melatonin signalling mediates the photoperiodic change in testicular retrotransposon expression.
statements.evidence: Photoperiod is a pivotal factor in affecting spermatogenesis in seasonal-breeding animals.
statements.note: The study links photoperiod to transposon and gene expression but examines no hormonal mediator such as melatonin.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: DNA transposons made up 0.70 % of the Brandt's vole genome, far less than the 7.54 % contributed by LTRs.
statements.evidence: Following closely, SINEs accounted for 10.13 %, LTRs for 7.54 %, and DNA transposons for 0.70 %.
statements.note: DNA transposons occupy 0.70 % of the genome, far less than the 7.54 % contributed by LTRs.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Expression of the differentially expressed retrotransposons correlated strongly and positively with expression of the genes next to them.
statements.evidence: Differential expression and Pearson analysis indicated strongly positive correlations between the expression of differentially expressed retrotransposons and the adjacent genes.
statements.note: This is the reported correlation between differentially expressed retrotransposons and adjacent genes.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: The synthetic isu peptide induced IL-10 production in human PBMCs when it was presented on the surface of porcine L23 cells.

alter.from: when it was presented on the surface of porcine L23 cells
alter.to: when it was added directly to the cells in solution

statements.evidence: coating porcine L23 cells with the synthetic isu peptide of the PERV p15E protein and subsequently co-incubating them with human PBMCs induced IL-10 production, whereas direct addition of the peptide to PBMCs alone did not induce cytokine production
statements.note: The isu peptide induced IL-10 only when presented on porcine L23 cells; added directly to PBMCs it induced no cytokine production.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Cells expressing p15E raised PBMC expression of IL-10, IL-6 and 24 further cytokines and shifted the expression of hundreds of genes.
statements.evidence: PERV p15E induced an elevated expression of IL-10, IL-6 and 24 other cytokines and modulated the expression of hundreds of genes.
statements.note: The abstract reports elevated IL-10, IL-6 and 24 other cytokines plus modulation of hundreds of genes.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: A construct giving higher p15E expression produced correspondingly larger effects on cytokine release than the earlier construct.
statements.evidence: Here, a new construct with a higher expression of p15E and consequently higher effects on cytokine release was designed and used.
statements.note: The new construct is described as expressing more p15E with consequently higher effects on cytokine release.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Blocking IL-10 signalling restores the cytotoxic activity of human PBMCs exposed to p15E.
statements.evidence: These results demonstrate that the PERV p15E protein can modulate cytokine release by human immune cells and suppress their cytotoxic activity.
statements.note: Suppression of cytotoxic activity is reported, but no blocking experiment tests whether IL-10 is responsible or whether blockade reverses it.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Methylated CpG biomarker levels were significantly higher in ASCC tissue than in normal tissue and in whole blood.
statements.evidence: CpG-methylated biomarker levels were significantly higher in ASCC tissue compared with normal tissue and whole blood.
statements.note: This is the reported tissue comparison for the methylated biomarkers.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In baseline plasma the assay reached an AUC of 0.72 for T1 or T2 tumors up to 4 cm and 0.90 for T2 tumors over 4 cm or T3 tumors.
statements.evidence: achieving an AUC of 0.72 (95% CI: 0.55-0.89; P = 0.018) in baseline plasma samples from ASCC patients with T1 or T2 tumors ≤4 cm, versus 0.90 (95% CI: 0.76-1.00; P = 0.0005) in plasma from patients with T2 tumors >4 cm or T3 tumors.
statements.note: Both AUC values and the stage groups they belong to are reported in the results.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Methylated-marker ctDNA measured after chemoradiotherapy predicts recurrence in anal squamous cell carcinoma patients.
statements.evidence: The AnMM-ddPCR assay enables HPV-independent ctDNA detection in plasma samples from anal cancer patients and supports its evaluation in future liquid biopsy applications.
statements.note: Only baseline plasma was analysed; no post-treatment sampling or recurrence outcome is reported, and the conclusion defers monitoring applications to future work.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: At a specificity of 91.30%, sensitivity rose with stage, from 52.94% in the lower-stage group to 88.89% in the higher-stage group.
statements.evidence: At a specificity of 91.30%, sensitivity increased with stage from 52.94% (95% CI: 30.96-73.83) to 88.89% (95% CI: 56.50-99.43).
statements.note: At 91.30% specificity, sensitivity increased with stage, from 52.94% to 88.89%.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Thymomas carrying more non-coding mutations respond worse to chemotherapy.
statements.evidence: Given the paucity of coding mutations observed in this disease entity, disruption of the non-coding landscape and mitochondrial heteroplasmic shift may be the primary cause of thymoma.
statements.note: The abstract proposes a role for non-coding disruption in tumour development but reports no treatment response or clinical outcome data.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Type B1-2 thymomas carried about 80 times more somatic mutations in non-coding than in coding regions, 1,671.3 against 21.1 per case.
statements.evidence: The total number of somatic mutations was approximately 80 times higher in non-coding regions than in coding regions in type B1-2 thymomas (1,671.3 vs. 21.1 per case).
statements.note: The ratio and both per-case mutation counts are reported in the results.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Six recurrent non-coding mutations were detected, affecting IRF8, the E3 ubiquitin ligases UBR2 and RNF213, and three intergenic regions.
statements.evidence: A systematic non-coding analysis identified a total of 405.0 mutations per case on cis-regulatory elements, and detected six recurrent mutations: one interferon regulatory factor ( IRF8 ), two E3 ubiquitin ligases ( UBR2 and RNF213 ), and three intergenic regions.
statements.note: The non-coding analysis detected six recurrent mutations: IRF8, UBR2, RNF213 and three intergenic regions.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Mitochondrial heteroplasmy was present in 90% of cases, with a large share of the mutations falling in the D-loop region.
statements.evidence: Mitochondrial heteroplasmy was observed in 90% of cases, with a significant proportion of mutations located in D-loop region.
statements.note: Both the 90% figure and the D-loop enrichment are reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Glofitamab monotherapy gave an interim overall response rate of 75%, with complete responses in half of the patients, and median progression-free survival of 15.4 months.
statements.evidence: Glofitamab monotherapy achieved an interim overall response rate of 75%, including 50% complete responses. Median progression-free survival was 15.4 months, and median overall survival was not reached.
statements.note: The response rates and median progression-free survival are reported as stated.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Early clearance of CSF ctDNA went with radiographic response, while ctDNA that persisted or re-emerged came before clinical progression.
statements.evidence: Longitudinal ctDNA analysis demonstrated that early molecular clearance was associated with radiographic response, while persistent or re-emergent ctDNA preceded clinical progression.
statements.note: Persistent or re-emergent CSF ctDNA preceded clinical progression, while early molecular clearance went with radiographic response.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Glofitamab was detectable in the cerebrospinal fluid of 60% of patients, with CSF to plasma ratios reaching 0.44%.
statements.evidence: Glofitamab was detectable in the CSF of 60% of patients, with CSF/plasma ratios up to 0.44%.
statements.note: The detection frequency and the maximum CSF/plasma ratio are reported.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Glofitamab monotherapy gives longer progression-free survival than CAR-T therapy in relapsed or refractory primary CNS lymphoma.
statements.evidence: In several patients, glofitamab was used as a bridge to subsequent CAR-T and/or autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT), which may have influenced long-term outcomes.
statements.note: CAR-T appears only as consolidation after glofitamab in some patients; no comparison of the two treatments is made.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: The 63 plasma-only alterations occurred in 18% of patients and were seen more often in those with prior targeted treatments (24%) than with chemotherapy (10%).

alter.from: in those with prior targeted treatments (24%) than with chemotherapy (10%)
alter.to: in those with prior chemotherapy (24%) than with targeted treatments (10%)

statements.evidence: Notably, 63 plasma-only alterations were identified in 18% of patients and were more frequently observed in those with prior targeted treatments (24%) compared to chemotherapy (10%).
statements.note: Plasma-only alterations were more frequent after prior targeted treatments (24%) than after chemotherapy (10%).

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Tissue and plasma alterations agreed in about 72% of patients, and the degree of agreement depended on cancer type, tumor burden and metastatic location.
statements.evidence: About 72% of the patients showed concordant alterations from tissue and plasma. The level of concordance was associated with the cancer type, tumor burden, and metastatic location.
statements.note: Both the concordance figure and the clinical factors associated with it are reported.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Patients profiled with the decentralized assay began targeted therapy sooner than patients profiled by a centralized laboratory.
statements.evidence: Implementing a flexible, decentralized sequencing system at point of care, with minimal technical oversight, can enhance turnaround times and patient access to genomic profiling.
statements.note: Faster turnaround is given as the rationale; the study measured sequencing feasibility and tissue-plasma concordance, not time to treatment against a centralized comparator.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Sequencing succeeded significantly more often for plasma cfDNA than for archived tumor tissue, 99% versus 96%.
statements.evidence: Sequencing success rates for cfDNA genomic profiling was significantly higher than archived tumor tissue (99% vs 96%).
statements.note: The two success rates and the direction of the difference are reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Four of the six callers evaluated, FreeBayes, VarScan, MuTect2 and Pisces, gave the best overall performance on the HD789 reference data.
statements.evidence: Overall, FreeBayes, VarScan, MuTect2, and Pisces had the best performance on HD789 data.
statements.note: Six callers were compared and these four are named as the best performers.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: FreeBayes called the largest number of somatic variants in every sample and also included more potential artifacts.
statements.evidence: FreeBayes consistently called the largest number of somatic variants in each sample but also included more potential artifacts.
statements.note: FreeBayes consistently called the largest number of somatic variants in each sample, artifacts included.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: A consensus call set combining two or more of the six callers detected known somatic variants more accurately than any single caller.
statements.evidence: The variant callers were evaluated by their level of concordance and performance on known somatic variants.
statements.note: Concordance between callers was measured, but no performance figure for a combined or consensus call set is reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: FreeBayes ranked among the best-performing callers on HD789 even though its call sets contained more probable artifacts.
statements.evidence: FreeBayes consistently called the largest number of somatic variants in each sample but also included more potential artifacts. Overall, FreeBayes, VarScan, MuTect2, and Pisces had the best performance on HD789 data.
statements.note: The two result sentences together place FreeBayes among the best performers while noting its artifact burden.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In Drosophila strains infected with three different viruses, infection consistently altered transposable element transcript abundance.
statements.evidence: Through deep RNA-seq and small RNA-seq analyses, we show that viral infection consistently alters TE transcript abundance
statements.note: Three viruses were used and viral infection is reported to alter TE transcript abundance consistently.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Invertebrate Iridescent virus 6 carries transposable elements of its own, which the study characterizes as a dynamic repertoire.
statements.evidence: In addition, one of the viruses under study, the Invertebrate Iridescent virus 6 (IIV6), carries TEs on its own, which we characterize as a dynamic repertoire.
statements.note: The abstract states that IIV6 itself carries TEs and describes their repertoire as dynamic.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: How strongly and in which direction infection modulated transposable element transcripts depended on the host strain, the virus and the tissue.

alter.from: depended on the host strain, the virus and the tissue
alter.to: was uniform across host strains, viruses and tissues

statements.evidence: However, the magnitude and direction of the TE modulation depend on the host strain, the virus, and the tissue.
statements.note: The magnitude and direction of TE modulation depended on the host strain, the virus and the tissue.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The transposable elements carried by IIV6 were acquired from the Drosophila host genome during infection.
statements.evidence: In addition, we provide an in-depth characterization of the dynamic TE repertoire that IIV6 carries.
statements.note: The virus's TE repertoire is characterized, but the abstract says nothing about where those elements came from.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Patients whose bile tract tumors carried ADAMTS7 mutations survived longer than patients without them.
statements.evidence: Several genes with differences in mutation accumulation between groups were identified, including ADAMTS7, AHNAK2, and CAPN10.
statements.note: Mutation accumulation was compared by vascular invasion status; no survival or prognosis analysis is reported.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Samples without vascular invasion showed a higher prevalence of gene mutations than samples with vascular invasion.
statements.evidence: A higher prevalence of gene mutations was observed in samples without vascular invasion than in those with vascular invasion.
statements.note: Mutation prevalence was higher in the samples without vascular invasion.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Each bile tract cancer case carried on average 53,705 somatic mutations, of which single-nucleotide variants made up 85.02%.
statements.evidence: The average number of somatic mutations detected in each case was 53,705, with SNVs accounting for most of these mutations (85.02%).
statements.note: Both the average mutation count per case and the SNV share are reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: None of the 331 bile tract cancer mutations catalogued in TCGA were found among the mutations identified in these samples.
statements.evidence: None of the 331 mutations related to BTC in The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) database were found in the mutations identified in our study.
statements.note: The results state that none of the 331 TCGA BTC-related mutations appeared in this cohort.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Higher SSTR2 expression in hepatocellular carcinoma went with significantly poorer overall and disease-specific survival.
statements.evidence: Elevated SSTR2 expression correlates with significantly poorer overall and disease-specific survival.
statements.note: The survival analyses link elevated SSTR2 to significantly worse overall and disease-specific survival.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Treating hepatocellular carcinoma cells with a somatostatin analogue reduced their invasion in culture.
statements.evidence: These data support the rationale for further development of SSTR2-directed therapeutic strategies to inhibit tumor growth and invasion in HCC patients.
statements.note: The work is a computational analysis of public data; no SSTR2-directed drug or cell experiment was performed, and the conclusion only argues for future development.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Of the 22 tumor types surveyed, hepatocellular carcinoma showed moderate SSTR2 expression in the majority of its tumors.
statements.evidence: SSTR2 is moderately expressed in the majority of HCC tumors.
statements.note: Within a pan-cancer survey of 22 tumor types, the results report moderate SSTR2 expression in most HCC tumors.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: High SSTR2 levels accompanied activation of oncogenic signaling cascades tied to proliferation, epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, angiogenesis and metastasis.
statements.evidence: High SSTR2 levels are associated with activation of oncogenic signaling cascades related to cell proliferation, epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT), angiogenesis, and metastasis.
statements.note: High SSTR2 levels were associated with activation of these oncogenic cascades, not with their suppression.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Copies of mCi-hAT1 sat mainly on the chromosome arms, whereas mCi-hAT4 copies were spread more evenly along the chromosomes.
statements.evidence: mCi-hAT1 was primarily located in the chromosome arms, a pattern observed in the transposable elements of other Caenorhabditis species, whereas mCi-hAT4 was more evenly distributed across chromosomes.
statements.note: The two MITE families are reported to differ in distribution exactly this way.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: C. inopinata genes with MITE insertions upstream or in introns tended to be expressed more highly than their C. elegans orthologues.
statements.evidence: interspecific transcriptome analysis indicated that C. inopinata genes with upstream or intronic these miniature inverted-repeat transposable element insertions tend to be more highly expressed than their orthologous genes in C. elegans
statements.note: Genes with upstream or intronic MITE insertions tended to be more highly expressed than their C. elegans orthologues.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Three further autonomous hAT elements and over 1,000 copies of two non-autonomous MITE families, mCi-hAT1 and mCi-hAT4, were identified in C. inopinata.
statements.evidence: Further bioinformatic analyses uncovered 3 additional autonomous hAT elements-Ci-hAT2, Ci-hAT3, and Ci-hAT4-along with over 1,000 copies of 2 nonautonomous miniature inverted-repeat transposable elements, mCi-hAT1 and mCi-hAT4, likely derived from Ci-hAT1 and Ci-hAT4 through internal deletion.
statements.note: The counts of additional autonomous elements and of MITE copies are reported as stated.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The transposition rate of Ci-hAT1 in C. inopinata rises with culture temperature.
statements.evidence: We tracked at least 3 sequential transpositions of Ci-hAT1 over several years.
statements.note: Transpositions were tracked over years, but no environmental variable such as temperature was varied or measured.
